question: Should this runtime i18n PR localize gateway JSON message/reason fields, or should those protocol-facing fields stay stable while only chat/UI display copy is localized?
rationale: The code can mechanically preserve the authMode billing contract, but the gateway field boundary is a product/API contract choice that green tests cannot infer safely.

options.title: Keep Gateway JSON Stable
options.body: Localize chat/UI display copy while leaving gateway JSON message/reason strings stable unless a typed display field is added.

options.title: Confirm Display-Only Localization
options.body: Accept locale-dependent gateway message/reason text if maintainers confirm clients must rely only on stable code/type fields.

options.title: Pause Runtime Scope
options.body: Hold this PR until runtime/gateway localization boundaries are designed separately from setup wizard i18n.

recommendation.title: Keep Gateway JSON Stable
recommendation.body: Localize chat/UI display copy while leaving gateway JSON message/reason strings stable unless a typed display field is added.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc recently merged the overlapping billing contract and has current history in the affected agent/runtime path.
